positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed Modbus based embedded systems using C++ and Python for Solar Battery systems to work on a Virtual Power Plant (VPP). Modernized the codebase using more advanced C++ conventions. Created an  automated build, test and release packaging process using Github Actions and Docker. Authored the team's C++ programming standards. Developed a framework platform for new products utilizing U-Boot, Debian Linux, Watchdog Timers, AWS IoT, AWS Greengrass and AWS System Manager.
